mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.SeatMapper.list */ SELECT S.SEAT_ID AS seatId , S.SEAT_GRADE_ID AS seatGradeId , S.SHOW_DATE_ID AS showDateId , S.SHOW_ID AS showId , S.SEAT_NUMBER AS seatNumber , S.SEAT_STATUS AS seatStatus , S.BOOKED_NUMBER AS bookedNumber , S.BOOKED_DATE AS bookedDate , S.BOOKED_ID AS bookedId , SG.GRADE_NAME AS gradeName , SG.PRICE AS price FROM SEAT S LEFT JOIN SEAT_GRADE SG ON S.SEAT_GRADE_ID = SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SHOW_DATE_ID = #{showDateId} ORDER BY SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID ASC, S.SEAT_NUMBER ASC
mapper.update: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.SeatMapper.release */ UPDATE SEAT SET SEAT_STATUS = 'available' , BOOKED_ID = NULL , BOOKED_NUMBER = NULL , BOOKED_DATE = NULL WHERE BOOKED_NUMBER = #{bookedNumber}
mapper.select:
/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.SeatMapper.myTickets */ SELECT S.BOOKED_NUMBER AS bookedNumber , SH.SHOW_ID AS showId , SH.TITLE AS title , SH.PLACE AS place , SD.SHOW_DATE AS showDate , COUNT(*) AS count , SUM(SG.PRICE) AS amount , MIN(S.BOOKED_DATE) AS bookedDate , DATE_SUB(SD.SHOW_DATE, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS cancelableDate , GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(SG.GRADE_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER) ORDER BY S.SEAT_NUMBER SEPARATOR ', ') AS seatNames FROM SEAT S INNER JOIN SHOWS SH ON SH.SHOW_ID = S.SHOW_ID INNER JOIN SHOW_DATE SD ON SD.SHOW_DATE_ID = S.SHOW_DATE_ID LEFT JOIN SEAT_GRADE SG ON SG.SEAT_GRADE_ID = S.SEAT_GRADE_ID WHERE S.BOOKED_ID = #{userId} AND S.BOOKED_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
AND S.SEAT_STATUS = 'canceled'
AND S.SEAT_STATUS = 'booked'
AND S.BOOKED_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{period} MONTH)
AND DATE(SD.SHOW_DATE) = #{viewDate}
AND SH.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ticketName}, '%')
GROUP BY S.BOOKED_NUMBER, SH.SHOW_ID, SH.TITLE, SH.PLACE, SD.SHOW_DATE ORDER BY MIN(S.BOOKED_DATE) DESC
